form_note: same form as resident-runtime/test-suite-baseline-refresh.transition.json; the default writer placement proposed on StegVerse-org/.github#238 for #222: no 4th workflow and no hosted writer job; the receipt is produced read-only by a dispatcher catalog group and the append is a manifest-directed transition carried by organization-ledger-writer.yml once admitted

input.producer: resident-runtime/main_change_receipt.py observe over the pushed range (github.event.before..github.event.after) on a scratch copy
input.seal: receipt_sha256 = sha256 over canonical JSON without the field (B1 writer seal)

output.publish: NONE until admission: the receipts, the scratch append and the fresh-fetch verification are retained as workflow artifacts; nothing is committed, pushed or appended
output.consequence_carrier: .github/workflows/organization-ledger-writer.yml (the only workflow holding contents: write) once MAIN_CHANGE_RECEIPT_APPEND is admitted; no new workflow

admission.required_evidence_or_repair: the organization ledger declares its genesis and admits operation MAIN_CHANGE_RECEIPT_APPEND from it; organization-ledger-writer.yml then appends the retained receipts to refs/stegverse/main-change-receipts
admission.retry_entrypoint: tools/tasks/task_catalog.json group main-change-receipt.receipt (validation-dispatcher.yml, push to main)
admission.next_attempt: the first push to main after genesis admits MAIN_CHANGE_RECEIPT_APPEND

skap_vault_invariant: the SKAP Vault (KV/_Vault/SKAP) is the only PII and credential store for every user, including the StegVerse ecosystem's own PII and credentials; this transition reads, stores and moves no PII or credential
